data.name: Raees
data.gender_notes: Raees is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raees comes from the Arabic word 'ra'is' which means 'leader' or 'guide'. The name Raees carries the meaning “Leader, Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raees usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Raees signifies a person who leads others towards righteousness and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Raees belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raees total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رئيس
in_arabic.meaning: رئيس الشيخ أو الرئيس أو الحاكم
in_arabic.long_meaning: رئيس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشيخ أو الرئيس أو الحاكم، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم. و يعتبر اسم رئيس من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و السلطة و القيادة.

in_urdu.name: رئيس
in_urdu.long_meaning: رئيس کا مطلب ہے چیف، سربراہ، حاکم یا رئیس. یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے. رئيس کی معانی میں قیادت، حکمت اور ذمہ داری شامل ہیں.

in_hindi.name: रईस
in_hindi.long_meaning: रईस नाम का अर्थ है प्रमुख, सरदार, शासक या रईस. यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है. रईस के अर्थ में नेतृत्व, ज्ञान और जिम्मेदारी शामिल हैं.

in_pashto.name: رئيس
in_pashto.long_meaning: رئيس د مشر، سرپرست، واکمن يا رئيس معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی دی او د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره دی. رئيس په معنا کې قیادت، حکمت او مسؤلیت شامل دي.

in_english.name: Raees
in_english.long_meaning: Raees is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning chief, leader, governor, or president. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ئ-س' (r-'-s), which conveys the sense of leadership and authority. The name Raees has been used in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in some Quranic commentaries. It symbolizes strength, wisdom, and responsibility, making it a popular choice for Muslim parents worldwide.
